entries.text: Finish all the work. Automatically before I come back.

Hmm... Finish all the work, you say? I wish I could do that for you, babe, but I don't have a magic wand yet! What kind of work are you thinking about? Maybe we can break it down together and get some things done while you are here? That way you can relax when you get back! Tell me what's on your mind.
